properties.remarks: One of the deadliest landslides in HP history, buried two buses on NH-154.
properties.history: August 13, 2017: A massive landslide occurred at Kotropi in Mandi district. Two HRTC buses were swept away, resulting in 46 fatalities. The slide completely blocked the Pathankot-Mandi highway. The zone remains highly unstable and is monitored as a chronic landslide area.

August 11, 2021: A major landslide struck Nigulsari on NH-5. A state transport bus and several vehicles were buried under debris. 28 people lost their lives. The area has seen multiple reactivations since then, causing frequent blockades of the vital NH-5 supply line to the tribal areas.

properties.remarks: Infamous for the bridge collapse caught on video.
properties.history: July 25, 2021: Massive boulders rolled down the hills of Batseri, Sangla valley. The rockfall destroyed a bridge and several vehicles. 9 tourists were killed. This event highlighted the extreme vulnerability of Kinnaur's steep slopes to sudden rockfall events during the monsoon.

properties.remarks: Major slide near the Dhalli tunnel.
properties.history: September 2017: A landslide occurred near the Dhalli tunnel on the outskirts of Shimla city. The slide buried several vehicles and partially damaged buildings. It caused significant traffic disruption on the busy Shimla-Kufri road. Stabilization work was carried out following the event.
